events.title: Navigating OSAP: Your Guide to Applying for Financial Aid
events.excerpt: Are you a domestic student at Sheridan looking to navigate the ins and outs of the Ontario Student Assistance Program (OSAP)? Join us for an informative webinar where we will guide you through the pro…
events.description:
Are you a domestic student at Sheridan looking to navigate the ins and outs of the Ontario Student Assistance Program (OSAP)? Join us for an informative webinar where we will guide you through the process of applying for financial aid to support your postsecondary education.
Whether you're a first-time applicant or looking to renew your OSAP funding, this webinar is designed to equip you with the knowledge and tools you need to navigate the financial aid process with confidence.
Join us and take the first step towards securing the financial support you need to pursue your educational goals!
Note: We will be providing OSAP account password resets/OAN retrieval at the end of each session. If you require this service, please come prepared with your Social Insurance Number (SIN) number and to answer your OSAP verification questions.

events.title: Peel Postsecondary Pathways Exploration Event
events.excerpt: Explore your options after high school—all in one place. Grade 12 and 12+ students from across Peel Region and their families are invited to Sheridan College’s Davis Campus for the Peel Postsecondary …
events.description:
Explore your options after high school—all in one place. Grade 12 and 12+ students from across Peel Region and their families are invited to Sheridan College’s Davis Campus for the Peel Postsecondary Exploration Event.
Connect with representatives from a range of institutions and organizations, ask questions and learn more about:
Apprenticeship and skilled trades
College
University
Community and other postsecondary pathways
Employment and work-based pathways
Whether you’re comparing several pathways or looking for a clearer sense of what comes next, this event can help you gather useful information and make a more informed decision.
Registration is required, and capacity is limited. To help ensure the broadest possible access for PDSB families, please register only one parent or guardian and their Grade 12 or 12+ student(s) for one block.
Spaces are limited, so reserve your spot as soon as possible.
Date: Oct 14, 2026 Time: 5:00 p.m. – 8.30 p.m. Location: Davis Campus, 7899 McLaughlin Road, Brampton
The pathways fair will take place in the Student center (DEN/SSU). Parking for the event will be available in Lot 4,5 and 6. View campus map .
Note : Guests are welcome to arrive at any time between 5:00 p.m. and 8:30 p.m.
The following institutions and organizations will be represented at the event. Exhibitors will continue to be announced – please stay tuned to this page for updates.

events.description:
Date: Friday, November 20 Time: 12:00 PM Location: Virtual
Join us to learn how to start your stock investing journey! This beginner-friendly workshop is your starting point for stock investing. You’ll learn what stocks are, why they’re essential for long-term wealth, and how to match them to your goals and risk tolerance. We’ll cover stock types, potential returns, and market sectors, while also exploring how trading in a TFSA, RRSP, or non-registered account impacts taxation. Finally, you’ll gain practical tips on structuring your portfolio and finding the right balance of stocks to build confidence in your investing journey.
